rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) was injured by a hazardous condition on the policyholder's premises (icy walkway), which is the definition of premises liability.
claim_summary: Neighbor's 9-year-old daughter suffered a broken wrist after slipping on the policyholder's icy walkway during an ice storm last week. Medical bills are anticipated. Policyholder has active homeowners liability coverage with a $500k limit and $1k deductible.

case_facts.description: neighbor's 9-year-old daughter slipped and fell on icy walkway
